events.message: Engine stderr received for server {plugin}

diagnostic.description: Unclassified upstream stderr diagnostic; retained only for detailed diagnosis and never treated as an operation failure
diagnostic.reason: Language servers emit implementation-specific failure explanations only on stderr, so retain the original diagnostic wording for diagnosis after redaction and truncation rather than attempting an unstable parser.

truncated.description: Whether the upstream stderr line exceeded the 4096 byte reader limit

diagnostic.description: Original message from the window/logMessage params, redacted and capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes
diagnostic.reason: The language server owns the unstructured window/logMessage explanation and exposes no stable error code for it, so preserve its original wording after redaction and truncation.

severity.description: LSP MessageType mapped to a controlled severity word, e.g. error, warn, info or log
